camera: A direct front-facing, strictly two-dimensional drawing plane; no perspective, foreshortening or visible side faces.
materials: Solid fills, crisp narrow strokes, small arrowheads. No gradients, texture, glow, shadows or bevels. Tensor shape cues may express supplied dimensions. No physical surface materials or extrusion.
lighting: Uniform graphic contrast; no studio lighting, highlights, reflections, gradients or shadows.
background: A uniform light neutral graphic background #FFFFFF with open whitespace.
composition: Arrange the selected source objects on one common two-dimensional plane. Structure leads; role fills support it, unfilled containers recede. Align peers; reserve whitespace for branches and labels, not padded cards. Keep shared resources distinct and external context outside its real owner.
detail: A flat explanatory illustration of the selected source objects, ownership and relationships. Shape, alignment and typography establish the hierarchy.

labels.policy: Neutral sans-serif: medium object names, regular signals/conditions, subdued ownership headings. Typeset mathematics properly. No all-bold text or dark title banners. Print every selected object name once, using direct labels inside compact symbols. Keep group names subordinate and do not repeat member lists in perimeter callouts. Required text stays exact and legible.
labels.title: A small optional heading in negative space; the source title is available in the external caption.

palette_policy: Light role fills and quiet boundaries; structure and readable names carry the hierarchy. Role fills: compute #DCEAFF; storage #FFF0BE; control/state #EEE5FF; interface #FFFFFF. Ink #17324D; outline #6E8BAB. Equivalent roles share the same fill. Do not assign a different hue to each region or tint entire ownership containers.
freedom: Choose clear planar alignment, spacing and framing within the selected source scope.
Source identities, membership and selected relationships remain unchanged.

user_intent.description: Draw an English flat engineering system architecture figure titled 'Coherent Heterogeneous SoC'. This is a generic reference system, not a physical floorplan. Within one SoC boundary: a CPU Cluster contains CPU Cores and Private Cache; an NPU Cluster contains Tensor Engines and NPU Cache; Shared Resources contains Coherent Fabric and Shared LLC; Memory Interface contains DRAM Controller; Host I/O contains PCIe Endpoint. External DRAM and an External Host are outside the SoC boundary. Show only the high-level memory/request direction, not all response signals: CPU Cores → Private Cache → Coherent Fabric; Tensor Engines → NPU Cache → Coherent Fabric; Coherent Fabric → Shared LLC → DRAM Controller → External DRAM; External Host → PCIe Endpoint → Coherent Fabric. CPU and NPU caches are coherent clients; do not add bypasses, capacities, clocks, core counts, snoop routes or physical details. Draw all named modules and group ownership at a readable scale in a single figure. The reader should immediately see compute clients, shared coherence/cache, memory access, and host ingress. Generic conceptual architecture. English labels only.
user_intent.notes: Strictly flat, front-facing system illustration. White background, restrained blue compute clients and warm neutral memory. No perspective, shadows or materials. Keep the named ownership and selected request paths readable.
